title: docs: drop auto-top-up gross-amount column references from skills
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the `stripe_amount_paid`/`stripe_currency` references added for #14959 (closed, not merged)
- spending-analysis: gross auto-top-up cash is in Tinybird `stripe_event` (unattributed `payment_intent.succeeded` rows) or on the Stripe invoice
- abuse-detection: points at the Stripe invoice `amount_paid`
